inputs.text: [scared] I'm trying to turn away from it. I can feel myself trying, but my feet keep taking me back. Harry, can you feel that?
[tense] Yes. Don't fight it so hard you fall. Give me a second to look. It's making us repeat the step, and the figure knows where we'll be.
[scared] Can you break the floor lines with your wand? If you can open one gap, we might be able to get out of the pattern.
[tense] I can't keep aiming down while those things are coming at us. There's another way. The red table on our left. Could you turn it onto its side?
[scared] If you get me close enough to reach under the edge. Why? Harry, look at me. What are you about to bring down?
[tense] The chandelier. Across the ice, not on us. I need the table between us and whatever comes off it when it hits.
[scared] You can't see where all of it will fall. If a piece comes over the top, that table won't stop it.
[tense] I know. I don't have a safe version. But I can see the table and I can reach the chandelier. If we keep taking this step, that thing reaches us.
[scared] Get me to the edge. Give me the count before you cast, and don't let go until I've got both hands on it.
[tense] Three beats. We move on the third. If you can't get hold of it, tell me. Don't try to make it work just because I've started.
